lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102110112 · After Working Holiday Group Chat chat 4. Anis

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: How's it been returning to daily life?
Why did you create a new chat for this?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Because I wanted to talk in secret.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You and I are accomplices, remember?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Here, we can talk about what can't be seen by others.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Then, once we're done, we can delete it.
What did you want to talk about?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I just thought

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: you'd be curious as to

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: what happened after Pepper and I got back

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: to the Repair Center.
Ah, yes! I've been waiting for an update.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: the long and short of it is...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: nothing really happened.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So much so, that I'm starting to wonder if I was making a mountain out of a molehill.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Actually,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: come to think of it, there was one thing...
What was it?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: A surprise party.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Pepper wanted to celebrate the anniversary of my coming to work at the Repair Center,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: so she and the patients prepared a little shindig for me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: They really shouldn't have.
It's a cause for celebration, so why not?
That definitely sounds like Pepper.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I guess so. I don't really see it myself.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'm thankful that she's thinking about me, but still...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I was thinking the same thing, hehe.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: after going through that party,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I felt a bit weird.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I was convinced that

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: if I returned to the Repair Center,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: disaster would be imminent,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but it seems like nothing has changed.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I feel like a higher power has given me another chance.
You think so?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: A chance to continue my atonement.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Of course, this doesn't erase my past,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and I fully realize this new-found state of grace is only temporary.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: If there's anything I could point towards being different than before,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I guess I'd have to say that I don't feel the same temptation that I used to.
You've become stronger.
That's the Mary I know and love.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I think I wanted to hear that from you directly.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Perhaps that's why I told you this story.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Thank you, Commander,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: for being so supportive.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You've always been there for me, and kept me from doubting myself.
Don't mention it.
You should thank yourself. You're the one who did this.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I never take for granted how lucky I am.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: No, that's not true.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: If it weren't for you, I would have never gotten through this.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So please don't shortchange yourself.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Oh, right. If it's not too much trouble,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: could you pass on a message to Neon for me?
What should I say?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Can you tell her that

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I've threaded the shells like she suggested and hung them from the windows for decoration.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: All the patients love them.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: And also,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: tell her I'll give her three free health check-ups,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: so she has to be sure to show up for them!
I'm not so sure she'll be a fan of that 'reward'.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You don't think so?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I was going to give you the same gift.
As you can see, I'm as healthy as a horse.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: There's no way to  know for sure

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: just looking at the outside.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Especially for someone like you who is always on the front lines.
Um... sorry, I've got a meeting coming up.
Um... sorry, Anis just came to the Commander's Room.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: No problem, I'll just leave the reservation link here.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Once you've made your reservation, just leave a message.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: arc.com/healthcare/input_examinee_info

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll dismantle this room now

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and head back to my personal bla.
Okay.
Mary left the group chat.
